text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Legitimacy Act (Extension) Order,
1971, and shall come into force on the Ist day of January, 1972.

2. The Legitimacy Act, 1961, shall have effect with the modifications
set out in the Schedule to this Order and as so modified is hereby
extended to Sabah and Sarawak.
